title: Adapt
subtitle: 適應／調整，究竟是怎樣的「適應」？
description: 適應／調整，究竟是怎樣的「適應」？

words.note: 表示為了更合適、更有效或更舒適而作小幅度修改。
words.example: We adjusted the schedule to give the team more preparation time.
words.exampleZh: 我們調整了時間表，讓團隊有更多準備時間。

exercises.original: We adapted the schedule slightly to give the team more preparation time.
exercises.upgrade: We adjusted the schedule slightly to give the team more preparation time.

options.explanation: 小幅度修改時間表最自然。

exercises.original: She adapted the chair height until it felt comfortable.
exercises.upgrade: She adjusted the chair height until it felt comfortable.

words.meaning: 配合；因應；作出安排以適應
words.note: 表示為了滿足某人的需要或配合某種情況而作出改動或安排。
words.example: The course was redesigned to accommodate students with different learning needs.
words.exampleZh: 課程經重新設計，以配合不同學習需要的學生。

exercises.original: The timetable was adapted to meet the needs of part-time students.
exercises.upgrade: The timetable was changed to accommodate the needs of part-time students.

exercises.original: The venue was adapted so that wheelchair users could enter easily.
exercises.upgrade: The venue was modified to accommodate wheelchair users.

options.explanation: 這裡核心是配合使用者需要。
也可描述物理改動，但沒有直接突出「配合某類使用者」。

words.note: 表示面對新情況時採取行動或改變做法。
words.example: Successful companies respond to change quickly.
words.exampleZh: 成功的公司會迅速回應變化。

exercises.original: Strong organizations adapt quickly when customer demand shifts.
exercises.upgrade: Strong organizations respond to change quickly when customer demand shifts.

options.explanation: 強調面對變化採取行動。

exercises.original: Managers must adapt to changing market conditions.
exercises.upgrade: Managers must respond to change in market conditions.

options.explanation: 很自然地表達因應外部變化。

words.note: 表示對某個東西作出部分改變，使它更合適。
words.example: Engineers modified the design to reduce energy use.
words.exampleZh: 工程師修改了設計，以減少能源使用。

exercises.original: Engineers adapted the design to reduce energy use.
exercises.upgrade: Engineers modified the design to reduce energy use.

exercises.original: The software was adapted to work with older devices.
exercises.upgrade: The software was modified to work with older devices.

options.explanation: 很適合技術功能上的部分修改。

words.note: 表示把某事物改成和原來不同的狀態。
words.example: We altered the layout to improve accessibility.
words.exampleZh: 我們更改了版面，以改善可達性。

exercises.original: We adapted the layout significantly after the safety review.
exercises.upgrade: We altered the layout significantly after the safety review.

options.explanation: 表示把原本安排改成不同形式。

exercises.original: The team adapted its original plan after receiving new information.
exercises.upgrade: The team altered its original plan after receiving new information.

words.note: 直接表示某人改變自己的行為或方式以適應新環境。
words.example: He adapted himself quickly to the new working culture.
words.exampleZh: 他很快便適應了新的工作文化。

exercises.original: He adapted quickly to the new working culture.
exercises.upgrade: He adapted himself quickly to the new working culture.

options.explanation: 明確表示本人改變自己以配合新環境。

exercises.original: She had to adapt to a very different management style.
exercises.upgrade: She had to adapt herself to a very different management style.

words.note: 表示逐步適應新的氣候、海拔、環境或生活條件。
words.example: It took her several days to acclimatize to the high altitude.
words.exampleZh: 她花了幾天才適應高海拔環境。

exercises.original: It took the hikers several days to adapt to the high altitude.
exercises.upgrade: It took the hikers several days to acclimatize to the high altitude.

options.explanation: 高海拔環境是典型搭配。

exercises.original: New arrivals need time to adapt to the extreme heat.
exercises.upgrade: New arrivals need time to acclimatize to the extreme heat.

words.note: 表示一個人逐漸融入新的文化、群體或制度，也可表示吸收新資訊。
words.example: New employees need time to assimilate into the organization.
words.exampleZh: 新員工需要時間融入組織。

exercises.original: New employees need time to adapt to the organization's culture.
exercises.upgrade: New employees need time to assimilate into the organization's culture.

options.explanation: 強調逐步融入群體文化。

exercises.original: It can take time to adapt to a new social environment and its unwritten rules.
exercises.upgrade: It can take time to assimilate into a new social environment and its unwritten rules.

options.explanation: 強調融入新的社會環境。

words.note: 表示為某個特定人、群體或目的特別調整內容或方法。
words.example: The training was tailored to the needs of new managers.
words.exampleZh: 培訓按新任經理的需要作了調整。

exercises.original: The teacher adapted the lesson to the needs of younger students.
exercises.upgrade: The teacher tailored the lesson to the needs of younger students.

options.explanation: 按特定學習者需要量身調整。

exercises.original: The service can be adapted for small businesses.
exercises.upgrade: The service can be tailored for small businesses.

options.explanation: 按特定客戶群需要調整。

words.note: 表示按特定使用者或用途修改功能、外觀或設定。
words.example: Users can customize the dashboard to suit their workflow.
words.exampleZh: 使用者可以自訂儀表板，以配合自己的工作流程。

exercises.original: Users can adapt the interface to match their preferred workflow.
exercises.upgrade: Users can customize the interface to match their preferred workflow.

options.explanation: 數碼介面按個人需要自訂。

exercises.original: The software lets each team adapt its dashboard.
exercises.upgrade: The software lets each team customize its dashboard.

words.note: 表示把系統、設備或結構重新安排或重新設定，以適應新的要求。
words.example: The network was reconfigured to support remote access.
words.exampleZh: 網絡經重新配置，以支援遙距存取。

exercises.original: The IT team adapted the network to support remote access.
exercises.upgrade: The IT team reconfigured the network to support remote access.

exercises.original: The office was adapted so that more people could work collaboratively.
exercises.upgrade: The office was reconfigured so that more people could work collaboratively.

words.meaning: 重新校準；重新調整標準
words.note: 表示根據新資訊或新條件重新調整衡量方式、設定或策略。
words.example: The company recalibrated its forecasts after demand fell.
words.exampleZh: 需求下降後，公司重新調整了預測。

exercises.original: The company adapted its forecasts after demand fell sharply.
exercises.upgrade: The company recalibrated its forecasts after demand fell sharply.

options.explanation: 根據新資料重新調整預測。

exercises.original: After the first test failed, the team adapted its expectations.
exercises.upgrade: After the first test failed, the team recalibrated its expectations.

options.explanation: 很適合重新調整預期標準。

words.note: 表示在情況改變時迅速轉換方向、商業模式或策略。
words.example: The company pivoted to online sales when foot traffic declined.
words.exampleZh: 人流下降後，公司轉向網上銷售。

exercises.original: The company adapted its business model when in-store sales collapsed.
exercises.upgrade: The company pivoted its business model toward online sales when in-store sales collapsed.

exercises.original: The startup adapted quickly from consumer sales to business clients.
exercises.upgrade: The startup pivoted quickly from consumer sales to business clients.

words.note: 表示隨時間逐步改變和發展，以配合新的條件或需求。
words.example: The service evolved as customer expectations changed.
words.exampleZh: 隨著客戶期望改變，這項服務也逐步演變。

exercises.original: The service adapted gradually as customer expectations changed.
exercises.upgrade: The service evolved gradually as customer expectations changed.

options.explanation: gradually 表示長期漸進改變。

exercises.original: Teaching methods have adapted over time as technology has changed.
exercises.upgrade: Teaching methods have evolved over time as technology has changed.

options.explanation: over time 明確指長期演變。

falseSynonyms.zh: change 只表示變化；adapt 表示為了配合新條件而改變。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The weather changed. We adapted our plans to the new weather conditions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 接受新情況，不代表已改變自己的做法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He accepted the new policy. He adapted his workflow to the new policy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 學習可能幫助適應，但兩者不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She learned the new software. She adapted her workflow to use it effectively.

falseSynonyms.zh: cope 強調應付困難；adapt 強調改變自己或方法來配合新情況。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He coped with the pressure. He adapted his working style to the new role.

falseSynonyms.zh: adopt 表示採用；adapt 表示調整。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The company adopted a new system. Employees adapted to the new system.

falseSynonyms.zh: react 可以只是即時反應；adapt 通常包含後續改變。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She reacted quickly to the news. She adapted her plans after hearing it.

falseSynonyms.zh: transform 通常表示重大、深層改變；adapt 可以只是必要調整。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The merger transformed the company. Staff adapted to the new structure.

falseSynonyms.zh: fit 表示已經合適；adapt 表示透過改變令其合適。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This plan fits our needs. We adapted the original plan to fit our needs.
